description_en: Queries IP addresses in the IP address whitelist of an Anti-DDoS Proxy instance
description_zh: 查询针对DDoS高防实例的白名单IP
name: DescribeAutoCcWhitelist

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157459.html operation to query the IDs of all instances
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS高防实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157459.html查询所有DDoS高防实例的ID信息
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The keyword for the query. This keyword is used to specify the prefix of the source IP address that you want to query.

The keyword must be greater than three characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
使用源IP关键字查询，指定要查询的源IP的前缀。

必须大于3个字符
parameters.name: key_word

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. For example, to query the returned results on the first page, set the value to 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询请求时返回的页码。例如，查询第一页的返回结果，则填写1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page
parameters.name: page_size

AutoCcWhitelist.description_en: An array that consists of details of the IP address in the whitelist of the instance
AutoCcWhitelist.description_zh: 针对DDoS高防实例的白名单IP列表

DestIp.description_en: The IP address of the instance

EndTime.description_en: The validity period of the IP address in the whitelist. Unit: seconds. 0 indicates that the IP address in the whitelist never expires
EndTime.description_zh: 白名单IP的失效时间，单位：秒。0表示永久生效

SourceIp.description_en: The IP addresses that is contained in the IP address whitelist

Type.description_en:
The mode of how an IP address is added to the whitelist. Valid values:

manual: manually added
auto: automatically added
Type.description_zh:
白名单IP类型。取值：
manual：手动添加
auto：自动添加

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of returned IP addresses in the whitelist
